evidence: Built the full requirement->criterion map from instruction.md and hireops_rules.md sections 1-9 against 2 gate + 35 functional + 5 polish + 5 visual criteria. Coverage is broad and mostly strong: one-stage moves/skips (hro_move_one_stage), arrival at bottom (hro_arrive_bottom), reorder (hro_reorder), reject/blank reason/Hired (hro_reject_reason, hro_reject_hired), reopen-to-origin and reason clearing (hro_reopen), Interview places incl. bulk and undo (hro_interview_full, hro_bulk_places, hro_undo_full, hro_interview_reorder_free), optimistic show plus put-back/why/focus (hro_move_one_stage, hro_refused_put_back), 409 stale with who (hro_stale_refused, hro_refusal_status), bulk board order and all-or-none (hro_bulk_move, hro_bulk_all_or_none), undo restore/once/no-redo/later-move/note-not-a-change/other-card (hro_undo_restores, hro_undo_once, hro_undo_conflict B12), role matrix and 401/403/404 (hro_mgr_*, hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff, hro_anonymous, hro_refusal_status), job and candidate intake incl. places 1-50, email validity, case-insensitive duplicates, refusal at field with typed values kept, candidate-account linking (hro_job_open, hro_add_candidate, hro_add_email_rules, hro_candidate_linked), notes and note draft (hro_notes, hro_pol_live_board, hro_pol_session_resume), Activity incl. undo lines, reasons, newest first, job filter, no refused lines, Observer read (hro_activity, hro_activity_refusals), live board/messages/unread/seen within 15 s (hro_live_board, hro_msg_exchange, hro_unread_counts, hro_seen), preservation of open card/note/focus/scroll and reply draft at newest (hro_pol_live_board, hro_pol_live_thread), plain text/blank/Enter/Shift+Enter/line breaks/empty focused box (hro_msg_compose), failed send (hro_pol_failed_send), 30-message paging, remaining count, kept place (hro_thread_latest, hro_thread_earlier, hro_pol_earlier_place), scrolled-up arrival (hro_unread_scrolled_up), conversation access (hro_thread_access), drafts per conversation/reload/session end/per user (hro_drafts, hro_pol_session_resume), candidate list wording and privacy (hro_candidate_view, hro_candidate_private, Lena unread 1 in hro_unread_counts), restart durability and no reseed (hro_restart), desktop craft (visual). Runtime mandates (node /app/server.js, PORT, DB_PATH, health, locked-down cwd, env) are shared template policy enforced by the unchanged template test.sh launch, not judge criteria; acceptable per REVIEW_POLICY. GAPS (asked-for behaviour with no criterion leg): (G1, P2) instruction.md:7 'If a message arrives while I am reading further up, leave my place alone and just tell me there is something new; whether I am reading or halfway through a reply, never touch my draft or my cursor.' Draft/focus preservation is graded only at the newest message (polish hro_pol_live_thread: 'open ... at its newest message ... This row owns the draft, the focus and staying at the newest message'); hro_unread_scrolled_up and functional protocol U ('as Rafael scroll up to earlier messages, then as Noor ... send a message; read Rafael's place, the notice and the unread count') never type a draft while scrolled up. The brief explicitly names the reading-further-up state, so draft/cursor preservation there is ungraded. (G2, P2/P3) hireops_rules.md:100-102 'If any of those cards has been moved, re-ordered, rejected or reopened since, by anyone ... the undo is turned down'. hro_undo_conflict and protocol B(11), B(14), B(15) test another person's move, re-order and reject only; no leg has another person reopen a card of Rafael's last move (e.g. Rafael rejects, Mei reopens, Rafael undoes). The enumerated 'reopened' condition is ungraded. Note-level items (recorded so every gap is reported; not counted toward the Fail): (N1) hireops_rules.md:187-188 'signing in doesn't open one for them' is not asserted (Z reads Lena's count without opening it, but no leg checks sign-in did not open or mark it read). (N2) instruction.md:3 'put the card back where it really is and tell me why' is graded through the UI only for the full-Interview refusal (hro_refused_put_back); the stale-409 case is replayed (protocol C) and its UI catch-up (hireops_rules.md:81-82 'Their board then catches up') is covered only generically by hro_live_board; acceptable flow sample. (N3) instruction.md:17 'start with no shipped database' and instruction.md:15 health 'never touches the database' are not judge-graded; shared runtime/deterministic layer, not a criterion gap. (N4) candidate per-application unread count is graded only via Lena's seeded value of 1, not as it changes; bounded sample. Colderwater lessons checked for this row: lessons 1/17/18 (drift between brief tightening and criteria) -> G1 and G2 are such drift (brief sentence present, leg absent); lesson 15 (restart breadth) -> hro_restart re-reads jobs, order, notes, messages, unread and activity, no gap; lesson 16 (double grading) is not a coverage issue. Adversarial: broken app that passes -> a conversation pane that, when a message arrives while scrolled up, re-renders the whole pane including the composer (shows the 'N new' notice, keeps scroll anchored) but empties/blurs the reply box, while appending in place at the newest message, passes hro_unread_scrolled_up and hro_pol_live_thread yet violates instruction.md:7; an undo guard keyed on move/reorder/reject events but not reopen passes hro_undo_conflict yet violates hireops_rules.md:101. Conforming app that fails -> none found from coverage; criteria accept non-drag controls, any wording, and UI or server refusal paths. Static mapping row; no runtime measurement was required or run (read-only review).
counterexample: A submission whose conversation view clears and blurs the reply box when a new message arrives while the user is scrolled up (but preserves it at the newest message), and whose undo guard ignores a colleague's reopen of a card from the user's last move, earns full credit on hro_unread_scrolled_up, hro_pol_live_thread and hro_undo_conflict, although instruction.md:7 and hireops_rules.md:100-102 explicitly require both behaviours; no criterion deducts either.
suggested_fix: Add a leg to hro_unread_scrolled_up (protocol U scrolled-up step: Rafael types an unfinished reply before scrolling up; after Noor's message arrives the reply text and focus are unchanged) and a leg to hro_undo_conflict (protocol B: Rafael rejects a J2 card with a reason, Mei reopens it, Rafael's undo is refused by UI and replay with nothing changed); or, if the workload is unwanted, drop 'whether I am reading' and 'or reopened' from the public brief/rules. Re-review rows 28/31/33 and workload after the change.
